provenance.loader: precision.py and matrix_functions.py exec'd from source into in-memory modules registered in sys.modules; prismatic_envelope.sage patched in memory, preparsed with sage.repl.preparse.preparse_file and exec'd into a namespace G with sage.repl.user_globals.set_globals(G); bytecode writing disabled; one fresh worker process per case

patches.description: Insert one call to an external capture hook immediately before the Step 7 square_complete_bottom line (L733), handing over can0, phi0, can1, OKtoOKmodpi0 (red), OKtoOKmodpi1 (redN) and nablaP_OK. The hook stores copies; no value used by the computation is changed.

provenance.sign_convention: nablaOK is expressed in the generators g_u of the Sage implementation: for odd p they are the negatives of the generators of [AKN24, Construction 3.28] and nablaOK is the matrix of [AKN24, Section 7.1, Step 5]; for p = 2 they differ by units, so only the cohomology is compared.
provenance.precision_policy: KThy-Computation.ipynb cell 2 total_precision with exact integer floor-log: N = T + ilog_p(L-1) + sum_{q=p}^{i-1} n*v_p(q!) + n*floor(i*(i-1)/2) + T + 1, T = nygaard_exponent(p,i,n) (precision.py). W = Zp(p, N, type='capped-abs'), A = PowerSeriesRing(W, L) with L = n*i.
provenance.timing_note: sage_seconds = wall clock of syntomic_matrices + syntomic_cohomology inside the worker (excludes Sage start-up and KZPN load); 4 workers ran concurrently

conventions.p_adic_numbers: decimal strings of a representative in [0, p^prec)
conventions.W_element: list of f decimal strings: coordinates in the basis 1, x, ..., x^(f-1) of Z_p[x]/(h_tilde); here f = 1, h_tilde = ["0","1"], lists of length 1
conventions.polynomials: lists low->high degree of W-elements (E, E_normalized)
conventions.matrix: {rows, cols, index_convention, entries (row-major, W-elements), prec (absolute p-adic precision per entry as reported by Sage; capped-abs exact zeros report N)}
conventions.cohomology: h1/h2 = sorted exponent lists a_j with H = sum Z/p^{a_j}; [] = 0
conventions.notation: paper n = power of the uniformizer (Sage k), i = weight, L = n*i (Sage Fprec)
conventions.differentials: syntomic_cohomology (L1028-1069): d0 = block_matrix([[canmphi],[nablaN]]) (2(L-1) x (L-1)), d1 = block_matrix([[nablaR, -canmphiN]]) ((L-1) x 2(L-1)); H^2 = torsion of the elementary divisors of d1, H^1 = torsion of the elementary divisors of d0 (both over W = Zp capped-abs); exponents are p-adic valuations of the elementary divisors different from 0 and 1.

fields.N: working precision used (W = Zp(p, N, capped-abs))
fields.N_notebook_float_log: N the notebook's float math.log would have given (informational)
fields.sage_min_precision: second return value of syntomic_cohomology (skips zero entries)
fields.min_entry_precision_all: min absolute precision over all entries of canmphi, canmphiN, nablaN, nablaR
fields.min_entry_precision_d0: min absolute precision over all entries of d0 = [canmphi; nablaN]
fields.min_entry_precision_d1: min absolute precision over all entries of d1 = [nablaR, -canmphiN]
fields.h1_zero_elementary_divisors: number of elementary divisors of d0 that are 0 to precision (should be 0)
fields.h2_zero_elementary_divisors: number of elementary divisors of d1 that are 0 to precision (should be 0)
fields.checks: plan invariants evaluated on Sage's matrices (informational only)

index_conventions.can0: Sage can0 (L628-646). rows: index m-1 <-> F-weight m = 1..L-1 of the reduced Prism_R basis z^(m mod n) * prod_u f_u^(digit_u(floor(m/n))); cols: index j-1 <-> F-weight j = 1..L-1 of the N^{>=i} basis element E^(i-floor(j/n)) * z^(j mod n) * prod_u f_u^(digit_u(floor(j/n))); column j = coordinates of NF_R(that element).
index_conventions.phi0: Sage phi0 (L653-671). rows: index m-1 <-> F-weight m = 1..L-1 (Prism_R basis); cols: index j-1 <-> F-weight j = 1..L-1 of the N^{>=i} basis; column j = NF_R(z^(p*(j mod n)) * phi_divided(prod_u f_u^(digit_u(floor(j/n))))).

index_conventions.redN: Sage OKtoOKmodpi1 (L719-730). rows: index m <-> F-weight m = 0..L-2 (Prism_R basis); cols: index j <-> z^j, j = 0..L-2; column j = NF_R(z^j).
index_conventions.nablaOK: Sage nablaP_matrix_OK output (L587-600). rows: index m = 0..L-2 <-> coefficient of z^m in the g0-coefficient (Sage sign convention g0 = z0 - z1); cols: index j-1 <-> z^j, j = 1..L-1 (F-weight j); column j = g0-coefficient of NF_OK(-(z - g0)^j * v^i).
